title: Laptop battery drains in under an hour
body: My ThinkPad battery goes from 100% to 0% in about 50 minutes even with only Outlook and Teams open. It's about two years old.

title: Access to SAP FI module for new analyst
body: Please give our new analyst Lara Ojeda display access to the SAP FI module (transaction FBL1N). Manager approval attached.

title: Finance printer printing streaks
body: The Finance printer PRN-2F-02 on the 2nd floor prints grey vertical streaks on every page since Monday. We replaced the toner cartridge and it still happens. It affects everyone in Finance who prints there.

title: Slow Wi-Fi in meeting room C
body: Video calls in meeting room C freeze every few minutes. Speed test shows 3 Mbps there vs 200 Mbps at my desk.

title: Teams doesn't detect external webcam
body: Teams shows "No camera available" with my Logitech C920 plugged in. The Windows Camera app sees it fine.

title: Scan to email not working on Finance printer
body: Scan to email on the Finance printer PRN-2F-02 (2nd floor) fails with "SMTP connection error". Printing from the printer works fine, only scanning to email is broken. We need it to send signed invoices.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro license request
body: I need an Adobe Acrobat Pro license to edit and sign PDF contracts. Currently I only have Reader.

title: Suspicious email asking to verify payroll details
body: I received an email from "payroll-update@examp1e-hr.com" asking me to log in and verify my bank details. I didn't click the link. Forwarding as attachment.
